entries.content: For new Vue 3 code, prefer Composition API and <script setup> when compatible with repository conventions. Keep page orchestration, reusable presentation and stateful composables separated by real responsibility.
Keep page-local state local. Introduce shared/global state only when multiple real consumers and lifecycle requirements justify it.
Do not introduce a second routing, global-state, data-fetching or form approach beside an established project convention without an explicit architecture decision.
Validate a migrated route as a coherent slice before broad refactoring. Successful component compilation alone does not prove route-level contract preservation.
